description: This header defines B-tree map and multimap container classes (`absl::btree_map` and `absl::btree_multimap`) that are optimized associative containers using B-trees, similar to STL's `std::map` and `std::multimap`. It includes class templates, functions for swapping and erasing elements, and internal parameter structures.

classes.name: absl::btree_map
classes.description: An ordered associative container of unique keys and values, implemented with B-trees for efficiency, supporting standard map operations.

classes.name: absl::btree_multimap
classes.description: An ordered multimap container allowing multiple elements with equivalent keys, implemented with B-trees for efficiency.

classes.name: container_internal::map_params
classes.description: Internal template struct holding type parameters for B-tree map and multimap, including key, value, comparator, allocator, and configuration flags.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two B-tree map or multimap containers.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: Erases all elements satisfying a predicate from a B-tree map or multimap.
